title: Technical Screening Round 3 (TSR3)

objectives.description: By completing this technical screening, you will demonstrate your ability to perform basic Linux system administration tasks, including user and group management, sudo configuration, SSH key-based authentication, package installation, service management, Apache web server configuration, firewall configuration, and static network configuration. Complete the following tasks on your Linux machine. Follow the instructions carefully and verify each task after completing it.

steps: Create a user named robert.
Assign password to robert.
Create a group named devops.
Add user robert to the devops group.
Give user robert sudo privileges without requiring a password.
Do not add user to wheel group.
Open a new session to server 192.168.111.165 with your_VPN_username.
Generate SSH key  pair for your_user on 192.168.111.165.
Configure SSH key-based authentication from your_user on 192.168.111.165 to the user robert on your personal VM.
Verify that your_user can connect to robert on 192.168.111.165 using SSH key-based authentication without entering a password.
Make sure you are on your personal VM
Switch to the user root.
As user root, install the httpd package on your personal VM.
Start and enable the httpd service so that it starts automatically after a reboot.
Configure Apache to listen on port 8080 instead of the default HTTP port.
Apache configuration file: /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf
Set SELinux to permissive mode.
Restart the httpd service and verify that it is listening on port 8080.
Create or update /var/www/html/index.html.
Add the following content exactly:
I am configuring apache server in my TSR3
Allow TCP port 8080 through the firewall.
Verify that the firewall rule is active.
Access your Apache web server from a browser using port 8080.
Verify that the following message is displayed:
I am configuring apache server in my TSR3
Configure a static IP address on your machine using your existing IP address.
Use the following network configuration:
IP Address: <Your machine's existing IP>
Prefix: 22
Gateway: 10.90.0.1
Using the nmcli command, verify that ipv4.method is set to manual.
Ping gateway.
Ping google.com.

completion_message: Great Job! You have successfully completed Lab 230 — Technical Screening Round 3 (TSR3). All assigned tasks have been completed.
